summary.name: LogoMovo
summary.one_liner: LogoMovo is an AI-assisted logo generator that turns a brand name and description into editable logo directions that can be exported as SVG or PNG.
use_cases: generate logo ideas for a new brand
customize a logo symbol, font and colors
explore logo styles before hiring a designer
find a color palette for a brand
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a Studio where users enter a brand name, description and color direction, then generate logo directions. Users can customize the symbol, typography, colors, layout and tagline of a selected direction. Exports are editable SVG and high-resolution PNG, which the FAQ says are produced directly in the browser. AI creates up to 8 editable vector marks per request, and remaining directions come from a local SVG generator. The site also offers free-standing tools: a color palette generator, a random color generator with HEX and RGB values, and a business name generator.
notable: AI-assisted and local SVG generation, with the Studio identifying which directions are AI-made
Free instant tools for color palettes, random colors and business names
caveats: Studio requires an account and an active paid plan; top-up packs add AI requests to a subscription
The generator does not check trademarks or exclusivity; users must check availability and rights before commercial use
Subscriptions renew until canceled; refund requests are accepted within seven days of purchase
